CREATE TABLE person AS SELECT i AS person_id, 1930 + (i * 7) % 70 AS year_of_birth,
  CASE i % 5 WHEN 0 THEN 'U' WHEN 1 THEN 'F' WHEN 3 THEN 'F' ELSE 'M' END AS gender
FROM range(1, 61) t(i);
CREATE TABLE visit AS SELECT i AS visit_id, (i * 13) % 60 + 1 AS person_id,
  TIMESTAMP '2019-01-01 00:00:00' + to_days(CAST((i * 37) % 1400 AS INTEGER)) AS vstart,
  TIMESTAMP '2019-01-01 00:00:00' + to_days(CAST((i * 37) % 1400 + i % 6 + 1 AS INTEGER)) AS vend,
  CASE i % 3 WHEN 0 THEN 'ER' WHEN 1 THEN 'Inpatient' ELSE 'Outpatient' END AS vtype
FROM range(1, 151) t(i);
CREATE TABLE unit_stay AS SELECT visit_id * 10 + k AS unit_stay_id, visit_id, person_id, vstart AS ustart, vend AS uend,
  CASE WHEN visit_id % 3 = 0 THEN (CASE k WHEN 1 THEN 'Éveil' ELSE 'Zed' END) WHEN visit_id % 3 = 1 THEN 'Ward' ELSE 'Clinic' END AS unit
FROM visit, range(1, 3) t(k) WHERE k = 1 OR visit_id % 3 = 0;
CREATE TABLE lab_concept AS SELECT i AS concept_id, 'Lab ' || i AS concept_name, 'Measurement' AS domain FROM range(1, 9) t(i);
CREATE TABLE drug_concept AS SELECT i AS concept_id, 'Drug ' || i AS concept_name, 'Drug' AS domain FROM range(1, 6) t(i);
CREATE TABLE lab AS SELECT
  CASE WHEN i % 7 < 4 THEN i % 4 + 1 ELSE i % 8 + 1 END AS cid,
  CASE i % 5 WHEN 0 THEN NULL WHEN 1 THEN (CASE WHEN i % 7 < 4 THEN i % 4 + 1 ELSE i % 8 + 1 END) ELSE (i * 3) % 8 + 1 END AS scid,
  (i * 17) % 60 + 1 AS person_id,
  TIMESTAMP '2019-01-01 00:00:00' + to_days(CAST((i * 29) % 1400 AS INTEGER)) + to_hours(CAST(i % 24 AS INTEGER)) AS dt
FROM range(1, 401) t(i);
CREATE TABLE drug AS SELECT i % 5 + 1 AS cid, (i * 11) % 60 + 1 AS person_id,
  TIMESTAMP '2019-01-01 00:00:00' + to_days(CAST((i * 41) % 1400 AS INTEGER)) + to_hours(CAST(i % 24 AS INTEGER)) AS dt
FROM range(1, 201) t(i)

WITH linkr_patient AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p."person_id" AS patient_id,
    NULL AS birth_date,
    p."year_of_birth" AS birth_year,
    CASE WHEN p."gender" IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN CAST(p."gender" AS VARCHAR) = 'M' THEN 'male' WHEN CAST(p."gender" AS VARCHAR) = 'F' THEN 'female' ELSE 'unknown' END AS gender,
    p."gender" AS gender_source_value,
    NULL AS death_datetime
  FROM (SELECT * FROM "person" UNION ALL BY NAME SELECT NULL AS "person_id", NULL AS "year_of_birth", NULL AS "gender" WHERE false) p
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM linkr_patient)::BIGINT AS patients,
  ((SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM lab e) + (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM drug e))::BIGINT AS event_rows

WITH linkr_visit AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    v."visit_id" AS visit_id,

    v."vend" AS end_datetime,
    v."vtype" AS visit_type,
    NULL AS care_site_id,
    NULL AS care_site_name
  FROM (SELECT * FROM "visit" UNION ALL BY NAME SELECT NULL AS "visit_id", NULL AS "person_id", NULL AS "vstart", NULL AS "vend", NULL AS "vtype" WHERE false) v
),
linkr_concept_lab AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    d."concept_id" AS concept_id,
    NULL AS concept_terminology,
    d."concept_name" AS concept_name,
    NULL AS concept_code,
    NULL AS terminology_id,
    NULL AS terminology_name,
    d."domain" AS category,
    NULL AS subcategory,
    NULL AS record_count,
    NULL AS patient_count
  FROM (SELECT * FROM "lab_concept" UNION ALL BY NAME SELECT NULL AS "concept_id", NULL AS "concept_name", NULL AS "domain" WHERE false) d
),
linkr_event_lab AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    e."person_id" AS patient_id,
    e."cid" AS concept_id,
    e."dt" AS start_datetime,
    e."visit_id" AS visit_id,
    NULL AS visit_detail_id,
    NULL AS concept_terminology,
    NULL AS concept_code,
    e."scid" AS source_concept_id,
    NULL AS concept_name,
    NULL AS end_datetime,
    NULL AS value_number,
    NULL AS value_string,
    NULL AS unit,
    NULL AS unit_concept_id,
    NULL AS route,
    NULL AS route_concept_id
  FROM (SELECT * FROM "lab" UNION ALL BY NAME SELECT NULL AS "person_id", NULL AS "cid", NULL AS "dt", NULL AS "visit_id", NULL AS "scid" WHERE false) e
),
events AS (
  SELECT cid, pid, edate FROM (
    SELECT e.concept_id AS cid, e.patient_id AS pid, CAST(e.start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS edate FROM linkr_event_lab e/*LINKR_RANGE:WHERE:e.patient_id*/
    UNION ALL
    SELECT e.source_concept_id AS cid, e.patient_id AS pid, CAST(e.start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS edate FROM linkr_event_lab e WHERE e.source_concept_id IS DISTINCT FROM e.concept_id/*LINKR_RANGE:AND:e.patient_id*/
  ) _evts
  WHERE cid IN (SELECT concept_id FROM linkr_concept_lab)
),
per_concept AS (
  SELECT cid, SUM(n)::BIGINT AS record_count, COUNT(*)::BIGINT AS patient_count, (SUM((md5_number_lower('twin-db' || CAST(pid AS VARCHAR)) % 4294967296)) % 4294967296)::BIGINT AS patient_key
  FROM (SELECT cid, pid, COUNT(*) AS n FROM events GROUP BY cid, pid) _cp
  GROUP BY cid
),
per_visit AS (
  SELECT ev.cid, COUNT(DISTINCT v.visit_id)::BIGINT AS visit_count
  FROM events ev
  JOIN linkr_visit v ON v.patient_id = ev.pid AND ev.edate >= CAST(v.start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AND ev.edate < CAST(COALESCE(v.end_datetime, v.start_datetime) AS DATE) + INTERVAL 1 DAY
  GROUP BY ev.cid
)
SELECT
    pc.cid AS concept_id,
    d.concept_name AS concept_name,
    'lab' AS dictionary_key,
    d."category" AS concept_category,
    pc.record_count,
    pc.patient_count,
    pc.patient_key,
    COALESCE(pv.visit_count, 0)::BIGINT AS visit_count
FROM per_concept pc
JOIN linkr_concept_lab d ON d.concept_id = pc.cid
LEFT JOIN per_visit pv ON pv.cid = pc.cid

),
cells AS (
  SELECT (CAST(((year(CAST(v.start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP)) * 4 + quarter(CAST(v.start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP)) - 1) - ((year(CAST(v.start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP)) * 4 + quarter(CAST(v.start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP)) - 1) % 2)) // 4 AS VARCHAR) || '-Q' || CAST(((year(CAST(v.start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP)) * 4 + quarter(CAST(v.start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP)) - 1) - ((year(CAST(v.start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP)) * 4 + quarter(CAST(v.start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP)) - 1) % 2)) % 4 + 1 AS VARCHAR)) AS v_period,
    v.patient_id AS pid,
    v.visit_id AS vid,
    uvd.visit_detail_id AS uid
  FROM linkr_visit v
  
  LEFT JOIN linkr_visit_detail uvd ON uvd.visit_id = v.visit_id
  WHERE v.start_datetime IS NOT NULL/*LINKR_RANGE:AND:v.patient_id*/
),
per_cell AS (
SELECT v_period, COUNT(DISTINCT pid)::BIGINT AS patients, COUNT(DISTINCT vid)::BIGINT AS stays, COUNT(DISTINCT uid)::BIGINT AS unit_stays
FROM cells
WHERE v_period IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY v_period
),
keyed AS (
  SELECT v_period, (SUM((md5_number_lower('twin-db' || CAST(pid AS VARCHAR)) % 4294967296)) % 4294967296)::BIGINT AS cell_key
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT v_period, pid FROM cells WHERE v_period IS NOT NULL) _pc
  GROUP BY v_period
)
SELECT pc.*, k.cell_key
FROM per_cell pc
JOIN keyed k ON k.v_period = pc.v_period

  UNION ALL
  SELECT ('lab:' || CAST(e.source_concept_id AS VARCHAR)) AS concept, e.patient_id AS pid, CAST(e.start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS edate FROM linkr_event_lab e WHERE e.source_concept_id IS NOT NULL AND e.source_concept_id IS DISTINCT FROM e.concept_id/*LINKR_CONCEPT_IN:0:e.source_concept_id*//*LINKR_RANGE:AND:e.patient_id*/
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ('drug:' || CAST(e.concept_id AS VARCHAR)) AS concept, e.patient_id AS pid, CAST(e.start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS edate FROM linkr_event_drug e WHERE e.concept_id IS NOT NULL/*LINKR_CONCEPT_IN:1:e.concept_id*//*LINKR_RANGE:AND:e.patient_id*/

)

  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE patients >= 10)::BIGINT AS published,
  COALESCE(SUM(patients), 0)::BIGINT AS mass,
  COALESCE(SUM(patients) FILTER (WHERE patients >= 10), 0)::BIGINT AS published_mass
FROM x

WITH linkr_visit AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    v."visit_id" AS visit_id,
    v."person_id" AS patient_id,
    v."vstart" AS start_datetime,
    v."vend" AS end_datetime,
    v."vtype" AS visit_type,
    NULL AS care_site_id,
    NULL AS care_site_name
  FROM (SELECT * FROM "visit" UNION ALL BY NAME SELECT NULL AS "visit_id", NULL AS "person_id", NULL AS "vstart", NULL AS "vend", NULL AS "vtype" WHERE false) v
),
linkr_visit_detail AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    vd."unit_stay_id" AS visit_detail_id,
    vd."visit_id" AS visit_id,
    vd."person_id" AS patient_id,
    vd."ustart" AS start_datetime,
    vd."uend" AS end_datetime,
    NULL AS unit_id,
    (NULLIF(CAST(vd."unit" AS VARCHAR), '')) AS unit_name,
    NULL AS unit_category
  FROM (SELECT * FROM "unit_stay" UNION ALL BY NAME SELECT NULL AS "unit_stay_id", NULL AS "visit_id", NULL AS "person_id", NULL AS "ustart", NULL AS "uend", NULL AS "unit" WHERE false) vd
),
linkr_event_lab AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    e."person_id" AS patient_id,
    e."cid" AS concept_id,
    e."dt" AS start_datetime,
    e."visit_id" AS visit_id,
    NULL AS visit_detail_id,
    NULL AS concept_terminology,
    NULL AS concept_code,
    e."scid" AS source_concept_id,
    NULL AS concept_name,
    NULL AS end_datetime,
    NULL AS value_number,
    NULL AS value_string,
    NULL AS unit,
    NULL AS unit_concept_id,
    NULL AS route,
    NULL AS route_concept_id
  FROM (SELECT * FROM "lab" UNION ALL BY NAME SELECT NULL AS "person_id", NULL AS "cid", NULL AS "dt", NULL AS "visit_id", NULL AS "scid" WHERE false) e
),
linkr_event_drug AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    e."person_id" AS patient_id,
    e."cid" AS concept_id,
    e."dt" AS start_datetime,
    e."visit_id" AS visit_id,
    NULL AS visit_detail_id,
    NULL AS concept_terminology,
    NULL AS concept_code,
    NULL AS source_concept_id,
    NULL AS concept_name,
    NULL AS end_datetime,
    NULL AS value_number,
    NULL AS value_string,
    NULL AS unit,
    NULL AS unit_concept_id,
    NULL AS route,
    NULL AS route_concept_id
  FROM (SELECT * FROM "drug" UNION ALL BY NAME SELECT NULL AS "person_id", NULL AS "cid", NULL AS "dt", NULL AS "visit_id" WHERE false) e
),
x AS (
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT ('lab:' || CAST(e.concept_id AS VARCHAR)) AS concept, e.patient_id AS pid, CAST(e.start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS edate FROM linkr_event_lab e WHERE e.concept_id IS NOT NULL/*LINKR_CONCEPT_IN:0:e.concept_id*//*LINKR_RANGE:AND:e.patient_id*/
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ('lab:' || CAST(e.source_concept_id AS VARCHAR)) AS concept, e.patient_id AS pid, CAST(e.start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS edate FROM linkr_event_lab e WHERE e.source_concept_id IS NOT NULL AND e.source_concept_id IS DISTINCT FROM e.concept_id/*LINKR_CONCEPT_IN:0:e.source_concept_id*//*LINKR_RANGE:AND:e.patient_id*/
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ('drug:' || CAST(e.concept_id AS VARCHAR)) AS concept, e.patient_id AS pid, CAST(e.start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS edate FROM linkr_event_drug e WHERE e.concept_id IS NOT NULL/*LINKR_CONCEPT_IN:1:e.concept_id*//*LINKR_RANGE:AND:e.patient_id*/
),
cells AS (
  SELECT ev.concept AS v_concept,
    (CAST(((year(CAST(ev.edate AS TIMESTAMP)) * 4 + quarter(CAST(ev.edate AS TIMESTAMP)) - 1) - ((year(CAST(ev.edate AS TIMESTAMP)) * 4 + quarter(CAST(ev.edate AS TIMESTAMP)) - 1) % 2)) // 4 AS VARCHAR) || '-Q' || CAST(((year(CAST(ev.edate AS TIMESTAMP)) * 4 + quarter(CAST(ev.edate AS TIMESTAMP)) - 1) - ((year(CAST(ev.edate AS TIMESTAMP)) * 4 + quarter(CAST(ev.edate AS TIMESTAMP)) - 1) % 2)) % 4 + 1 AS VARCHAR)) AS v_period,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(vd.unit_name AS VARCHAR), '')) IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(vd.unit_name AS VARCHAR), '')) IN (/*LINKR_SERVICE_TOP*/) THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(vd.unit_name AS VARCHAR), '')) ELSE '__other__' END AS v_service,
    ev.pid AS pid, ev.edate AS edate
  FROM ev
  
  JOIN linkr_visit_detail vd ON vd.patient_id = ev.pid AND ev.edate >= CAST(vd.start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AND ev.edate < CAST(COALESCE(vd.end_datetime, vd.start_datetime) AS DATE) + INTERVAL 1 DAY
)
SELECT v_concept, v_period, v_service, COUNT(*)::BIGINT AS patients, SUM(n)::BIGINT AS records, (SUM((md5_number_lower('twin-db' || CAST(pid AS VARCHAR)) % 4294967296)) % 4294967296)::BIGINT AS cell_key
FROM (
  SELECT v_concept, v_period, v_service, pid, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM cells
  WHERE v_concept IS NOT NULL AND v_period IS NOT NULL AND v_service IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY v_concept, v_period, v_service, pid
) _pc
GROUP BY v_concept, v_period, v_service
),
pm AS (
WITH cells AS (
  SELECT (CAST(((year(CAST(v.start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP)) * 4 + quarter(CAST(v.start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP)) - 1) - ((year(CAST(v.start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP)) * 4 + quarter(CAST(v.start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP)) - 1) % 2)) // 4 AS VARCHAR) || '-Q' || CAST(((year(CAST(v.start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP)) * 4 + quarter(CAST(v.start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP)) - 1) - ((year(CAST(v.start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP)) * 4 + quarter(CAST(v.start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP)) - 1) % 2)) % 4 + 1 AS VARCHAR)) AS v_period,
    v.patient_id AS pid
  FROM linkr_visit v
  
  
  WHERE v.start_datetime IS NOT NULL/*LINKR_RANGE:AND:v.patient_id*/
),
per_cell AS (
SELECT v_period, COUNT(DISTINCT pid)::BIGINT AS patients
FROM cells
WHERE v_period IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY v_period
),
keyed AS (
  SELECT v_period, (SUM((md5_number_lower('twin-db' || CAST(pid AS VARCHAR)) % 4294967296)) % 4294967296)::BIGINT AS cell_key
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT v_period, pid FROM cells WHERE v_period IS NOT NULL) _pc
  GROUP BY v_period
)
SELECT pc.*, k.cell_key
FROM per_cell pc
JOIN keyed k ON k.v_period = pc.v_period
),
rng AS (SELECT MIN(v_period) AS lo, MAX(v_period) AS hi FROM pm WHERE patients >= 10)
SELECT
  COUNT(*)::BIGINT AS cells,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE patients >= 10)::BIGINT AS published,
  COALESCE(SUM(patients), 0)::BIGINT AS mass,
  COALESCE(SUM(patients) FILTER (WHERE patients >= 10), 0)::BIGINT AS published_mass
FROM x
WHERE v_period BETWEEN (SELECT lo FROM rng) AND (SELECT hi FROM rng)
